children: Danish biotech Orbis Medicine on Thursday announced a drug discovery partnership worth up to $1.4B with weight loss drugmaker Novo Nordisk
to develop treatments targeting cardiometabolic diseases.

is expected to make a strategic investment in Copenhagen-based Orbis as part of the collaboration, which leverages the latter’s AI-led nGen platform to develop oral macrocycle treatments for cardiometabolic targets.

Under the terms, the company is also entitled to receive up to $1.4B in upfront and potential development and commercial milestone payments from the Danish pharma giant in addition to tiered royalties on future drug sales.

“Together with Novo, we have an opportunity to unlock a new generation of oral medicines for cardiometabolic diseases and demonstrate the transformative potential of AI-enabled macrocycle drug discovery,” said Morten Graugaard, CEO of Orbis.

title: Novo and Orbis ink drug discovery deal worth up to $1.4B
